titleTr: Passive ve reported speech: işe alım evrakları

explainTr: Passive'te yapan kişi önemsizse ya da bilinmiyorsa nesneyi öne alırız: be + V3. Zamanı be fiili taşır: is checked, was checked, has been checked, will be checked, is being checked. Yapan kişi gerekirse sonda 'by' ile söylenir.

Reported speech'te başkasının sözünü aktarırken zaman bir adım geriye kayar: am/is → was, do → did, will → would, can → could, past simple → past perfect. Zaman ifadeleri de değişir: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before.
Aktarılan soruda düz cümle sırası kullanılır: 'He asked where I lived' (did yok). Evet/hayır sorusunda if/whether gelir. Emirlerde told + kişi + to / not to.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede pasif ek ile yapılır (yapıldı, gönderilecek). İngilizcede 'be + V3' gerekir; 'was sent' yerine 'sent' demek yanlıştır. Türkçede 'Yarın arayacağım dedi' gibi dolaylı anlatımda zaman kaymaz, İngilizcede kayar.
table: He asked if I had ID.

exercises.q: The background check ___ by the district last week.
exercises.whyTr: Yapan kişi önemsiz, geçmiş zaman: past passive (was completed).

exercises.q: All substitutes ___ to show an ID at the front desk.
Your badge ___ to you by email.

exercises.whyTr: Rules çoğul; present perfect passive: haven't been + V3.

exercises.q: She said, "I am excited." → She said that she ___ excited.
exercises.whyTr: Reported speech'te present, past'e kayar: am → was.

exercises.q: "I will call you tomorrow," Mr. Brown said. → Mr. Brown said he ___ me the next day.
exercises.whyTr: will → would; tomorrow → the next day.

exercises.answer: The substitute was asked to arrive at seven thirty
exercises.whyTr: Pasif: was + V3; ardından to + fiil.

exercises.q: "Do you have a license?" → The principal asked if I ___ a license.
exercises.whyTr: Evet/hayır sorusu if ile aktarılır ve düz cümle sırası kullanılır; have → had.

exercises.q: "Don't touch the projector," she told us. → She told us ___ the projector.
exercises.whyTr: Olumsuz talimat aktarımı: told + kişi + not to + fiil.

exercises.answer: He asked me where the office was
exercises.whyTr: Soru aktarımında düz cümle sırası: where + özne + fiil.

exercises.q: The files ___ kept in a locked cabinet. (be)
exercises.whyTr: Files çoğul; present passive: are kept.

exercises.q: He said he ___ called the day before.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişteki olay aktarılırken past perfect: had called.

reading.title: From interview to badge
reading.text:
After her interview, Hafsa was told that the district would contact her within a week. On Thursday, she received an email: "Congratulations! You have been selected as a substitute teacher. Before you can start, several steps must be completed."

The first step was a background check. Fingerprints are taken at the district office, and the results are sent directly to the human resources department. Hafsa was nervous because she had never done anything like that, but the clerk explained that every adult who works with children is checked. "It's mandatory in all states," he said. "Nobody is excused."

The second step was verifying her credentials. Hafsa had to bring her passport, her work permit, and her high school diploma from Turkey. The diploma had to be translated into English by an official translator, which cost forty dollars. Her documents were reviewed by a staff member named Ms. Alvarez, who said that she would return them the same day.

The third step was a short online training. Hafsa was asked to watch videos about student safety, emergency procedures, and professional behavior. After each video, a quiz had to be passed with a score of at least eighty percent. She failed the first one by one point, but she was allowed to try again. "The guidelines are updated every year," Ms. Alvarez told her, "so even experienced teachers repeat the course."

Finally, Hafsa was given a lanyard with her photo and a code for the attendance system. She was also reminded that the rules about privacy must always be followed. "What happens in the classroom stays in the classroom," Mr. Brown said with a smile. "Students' information must never be shared."

When she got home, Emre asked how it had gone. "It took three weeks," Hafsa said, "but I did everything. Now I am officially a substitute teacher."

questions.q: What was the first step after the email?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'The first step was a background check.'

questions.q: Why did Hafsa pay forty dollars?
options: Her diploma had to be translated
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'The diploma had to be translated... which cost forty dollars.'

questions.q: What happened when Hafsa failed the first quiz?
options: She was allowed to try again
She had to wait a year
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'she was allowed to try again'.

questions.q: What does Mr. Brown say about students' information?

writing.promptTr: Okul bölgesi insan kaynaklarına resmi bir e-posta yaz (120-180 kelime): Belgelerinin durumunu sor. Geçmişte sana söylenenleri reported speech ile aktar ve pasif yapı kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a formal email to the district human resources office (120-180 words). Ask about the status of your documents. Report what you were told and use the passive.
frames: I am writing to ask about ...
On Monday I was told that ...
Could you please tell me whether ... ?
writing.model:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,

I am writing to ask about the status of my documents. On Monday I brought my passport, my work permit, and my diploma to the district office. I was told that the documents would be reviewed within three days, and that they would be returned to me by Friday. The clerk also said that my diploma had to be translated, so I have already sent it to an official translator.

I have not received any email since then. Could you please tell me whether my background check has been completed? I would also like to know whether the online training must be finished before the first day of work, or if it can be done later.

I understand that many applications are processed every week, and I appreciate your patience. If any other documents are needed, please let me know, and I will bring them immediately.

Thank you for your help.

Sincerely,
Hafsa
checklistTr: En az iki pasif cümle kurdun mu (was told, will be returned)?
Reported speech'te zamanı bir adım geri aldın mı (would, had)?
'Could you please tell me whether...' kalıbını kullandın mı?
Resmi başlangıç ve bitiş var mı?

examSet.q: The schedule ___ changed twice this week.
examSet.whyTr: Schedule tekil; present perfect passive: has been changed.

examSet.q: Lunch ___ in the cafeteria at 11:30.
examSet.whyTr: Düzenli olay, yapan önemsiz: present passive.

examSet.q: The classroom ___ right now.
examSet.whyTr: Şu an süren pasif: is being + V3.

examSet.q: Students ___ not to run in the hallway.
examSet.whyTr: Öğrenciler söylenen kişidir: are told not to.

examSet.q: She asked Hafsa what time the meeting ___.
examSet.whyTr: Soru aktarımında düz cümle ve zaman kayması: started.
